text.text: For writers growing an audience and selling sponsor slots. Move each issue from idea to sent, link the sponsor who bought the slot and log subscribers every Monday.
Run this list every time, even on the issue you are sure about. Mistakes in a send go to every reader at once and cannot be recalled.
Mark the issue Sent and enter the open and click rates two days later.
Reply to any reader who answered the sign-off question.
Add one line in the growth log about what drove signups this week.
Fifteen minutes on Monday keeps the whole picture honest. The point is the trend, not any single week.
Log subscribers and net new in the growth log.
Enter last issue's open and click rates.
Note one thing that moved the numbers.
Pick the next issue and set its send date.

Compare Growth this week (%) against the last four weeks, not against a target. A flat line with rising open rates usually means the list is healthier even if it is not bigger. A rising list with falling open rates is worth a look at where the new readers came from.
